title: Diamond Determinants and Somos Sequences
summary: A Somos sequence of order $n$ is defined by a quadratic recurrence of width $n + 1$. Some of the remarkable properties of these sequences for small $n$ are tied to certain matrices built out of them being of finite rank. We give an elementary proof of the finite-rank property for order $6$, previously only established with the help of advanced machinery from the theory of hyperelliptic functions.
